name: vocabkitchen
description: VocabKitchen tools for Claude Code — English vocabulary and grammar profiling by CEFR level.

plugins.name: vocab-profiler
plugins.description: Profile the CEFR level (A1–C2) and academic-vocabulary density (AWL/NAWL) of English text. Dependency-free Python 3.

plugins.name: grammar-profiler
plugins.description: Profile the grammar of English text by CEFR level — which constructions it uses (tenses, aspect, passive, modals, relative clauses, conditionals) and what level each maps to. Rule-based over a spaCy parse; uses the CEFR-J Grammar Profile. Requires Python 3, spaCy, and the en_core_web_sm model.

plugins.name: text-report
plugins.description: One command that runs both profilers and answers "is this text right for my class?" — vocabulary band + grammatical range + blended estimated level, with --target-level flags, a coverage figure, and a verdict. Exports pre-teaching handouts, fill-the-gap worksheets, and RubricMaker-importable flashcard decks (enriched with free-dictionary definitions). Requires Python 3; the grammar half needs spaCy and the en_core_web_sm model.
